annotations.title: Stop watching a company or activity

description: Stop watching a company (cui) or a CAEN activity code (code, plus the county it was watched in, if any), on your API key: the watch and its baseline are removed. Unwatching something you do not watch changes nothing (removed: 0). poll_watchlist lists your active watches.

code.description: A watched CAEN activity code (e.g. '6210'); give this or cui.
code.title: Code

county.description: With code: the county the code was watched in (diacritic-insensitive); omit for a nationwide watch.
county.title: County

cui.description: CUI of a watched firm (e.g. '2816464'); give this or code.
cui.title: Cui

name: unwatch

outputSchema.description: The watch removed (or not held), and the watches you still hold.

active.description: The watches you still hold (as in poll_watchlist).

county.description: The CAEN watch's county; null for nationwide or a company.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

ok.description: true when the request was valid.

owner.description: Whose watches these are (key prefix or IP).

removed.description: 1 when the watch was removed, 0 when you did not hold it.

title: Stop watching a company or activity
